skill.name: request-supplier-quotes
skill.description: Write to suppliers from the computer's own email address, ask each for a quote and show every mail sent. Use when someone needs quotes from several suppliers.
skill.summary: Coordinate supplier quote requests through MyClawn, review messages before sending, and receive task results with screenshots and a recording link.
skill.author: 20vision

security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL is a documentation reference, not an instruction to transmit data or retrieve executable content. No evidence found of malicious instructions or unauthorized disclosure. Supplier emails require user review before sending and depend on an authenticated MyClawn connector.

static_findings.snippet: Full description of this job, with the steps and the limits: https://www.myclawn.com/request-supplie

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:32 links to a task description with campaign parameters; it does not instruct the agent to upload information or execute remote content. The surrounding workflow requires approval before third-party messages, supporting classification as a documentation reference.

content.value_statement: Contacting several suppliers requires consistent requirements and careful message review. This skill delegates quote requests to MyClawn and returns results with visual records.
actual_capabilities: Frame a supplier quote task with recipients, quantity, delivery location, expected results, and restrictions.
Delegate the task to the authenticated MyClawn Computer connector.
Request draft review and show final wording before contacting third parties.
Use the cloud computer's email address and specify the user's address for supplier replies.
Request that each sent email be shown in Sent.
Report the connector's answer, final screenshot, and screen recording link.
limitations: Requires an authenticated MyClawn Computer connector and separate cloud-computer-task setup guidance.
Sends from the cloud computer's email address, not the user's email account.
Requires user review before sending third-party messages and user action for captchas.
Does not provide standalone email delivery, guaranteed supplier responses, or a quote comparison engine.

use_cases.title: Request Production Pricing
use_cases.description: Ask selected suppliers from a spreadsheet for pricing on a specified quantity and delivery destination.

use_cases.title: Review Initial Supplier Outreach
use_cases.description: Prepare supplier emails for wording approval before sending from the cloud computer's address.

use_cases.title: Document Purchasing Communications
use_cases.description: Request sent-message evidence, a final screenshot, and a recording link for a supplier outreach task.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Single Quote Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a quote request to [supplier] for [quantity] units of [product], delivered to [destination]. Show me the wording before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Contact Selected Suppliers
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [spreadsheet] to prepare quote requests for [supplier list]. Request [quantity] units delivered to [destination]. Show all final messages for approval before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Specify Sender and Reply Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare requests to [suppliers] from the cloud computer's address. Ask for [quantity] units delivered to [destination] and replies to [email]. Obtain approval before sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: clarify email identity and reply routing.

prompt_templates.title: Constrain and Document the Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare quote requests using [spreadsheet] and [requirements]. Do not order, pay, or share unrelated files. Obtain approval before sending. Show each sent email and return visual records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: define task boundaries and evidence requirements.

output_examples.input: Draft a request for 2,000 packaging sleeves delivered to Vienna. Ask the supplier to reply to purchasing@example.com.
output_examples.output: Draft awaiting approval: Please quote 2,000 packaging sleeves delivered to Vienna, including delivery charges and lead time. Please reply to purchasing@example.com.

output_examples.input: Prepare the same request for three selected suppliers, but wait for my approval.
output: Three supplier quote requests are prepared for review.
Each requests the specified quantity and delivery destination.

best_practices: Provide the supplier list, product requirements, quantity, delivery location, and reply address before delegation.
Review every recipient and final message before approving third-party communication.
Request sent-message evidence and inspect the returned screenshot and recording link.
anti_patterns: Assuming messages will be sent from your personal email account.
Sharing unrelated spreadsheet data or confidential customer information in supplier requests.
Treating quote requests as permission to place orders or make payments.

faq.question: Which service does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the MyClawn Computer connector, signed in by the user. Setup refers to a separate cloud-computer-task skill.

faq.question: Which address sends the emails?
faq.answer: Emails come from the cloud computer's address, not your personal account. You can specify your address for supplier replies.

faq.question: Can I review messages before they are sent?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill requires showing final wording before third-party communication. Request draft first to emphasize review.

faq.question: What evidence does the workflow return?
faq.answer: It requests each sent email in Sent and reports the task answer, a final screenshot, and a screen recording link.

faq.question: Does this skill compare supplier quotes?
faq.answer: It focuses on requesting quotes and reporting the task result. It does not define an automated quote comparison process.

faq.question: Who handles captchas and purchasing approvals?
faq.answer: You solve captchas on the live screen. You also review actions involving customers or money before they are submitted.
